feed.title: The Long View

bullets: Macro is risk management at scale; the job is mostly not being on the wrong side of a regime change, and a regime change you can name in advance is one you can position for.
The economy is a system, not a set of levers — pulling one lever moves three others, so treating correlated parts as independent causes misses in backtests.
A macro book and a power grid are both systems of correlated risk; systems thinking and risk management are one discipline, just with different vocabulary.
